summary: Completed testing of Achievement System and Customizable Child Dashboard features. All 25 backend API tests passed. Frontend UI components (Achievements page, PersonalGoals, QuickShortcuts, AchievementPreview widgets) working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Achievement System implemented correctly with 23 achievements across streak/milestone/family/seasonal categories
Personal Goals CRUD operations working - create, read, update, delete, increment progress
Quick Shortcuts API working - get and update with max 6 limit enforced
Dashboard config endpoint returns user-specific configuration
Family Wall poll creation with string array options converts to proper object format
Poll voting works correctly with duplicate vote prevention
